title: English Conversation 41:  A Rude Clerk
content: 1. May I speak with...?: a common question used on the phone to ask to talk with a certain person A) May I speak with James please? B) One moment please. A) May I speak with Karen? B) She is out of the office at the moment. Please call back later. 2. I'm sorry to hear that.: a sentence used after hearing bad or unfortunate news A) My grandmother is very sick these days. B) I'm sorry to hear that. A) I didn't get the job. B) I'm sorry to hear that. 3. as soon as possible: quickly; fast - Please give me your answer as soon as possible. - We need to finish this report as soon as possible.
